login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your app credentials to open the professional dashboard.
login.blocked: Your account has been blocked and your session has been closed. For information, write to <link>support@stressindex.io</link>.
login.noAccount: Don't have an account yet? <link>Start for free →</link>

recover.title: Forgot your password
recover.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a link to reset your password.
recover.sent: We sent you an email with instructions to reset your password. Check your spam folder too.

recovery.title: New password
recovery.intro: Choose a new password for your Stress Index account.
recovery.done: Password updated. You can now sign in with your new credentials, both on the website and in the app.

invite.title: Set your password
invite.intro: Welcome to Stress Index. Choose a password to activate your account.
invite.done: Account activated. You can now sign in with your email and the password you just chose.

setPassword.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters
setPassword.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match
setPassword.sessionExpired: The recovery session has expired. Request a new reset link.

errors.sameBrowserTitle: Open the link in the same browser
errors.sameBrowserDetail: For security, the reset can only be completed from the browser and device you requested it from. If you requested the reset on your computer and are opening the email on your phone (or the other way round), open this link from there. If that is not possible, request a new link from this device.
errors.expiredDetail: Reset links work once and expire after a short time. Request a new one: it will arrive by email right away.
errors.expiredExchangeDetail: The reset could not be completed with this link. Request a new one.
errors.invalidDetail: The link was not recognized. Request a new one.
errors.sessionDetail: The link token can no longer be used. Request a new reset link.
errors.tokenInvalidDetail: The token is no longer valid. Request a new reset link.
errors.missingDetail: This page must be opened from the link you received by email. If you copied the address by hand you may have lost the final part: open the link from the email again, or request a new one.
errors.unexpectedDetail: The link could not be validated. Try requesting a password reset again.

suspended.title: Account suspended
suspended.body: Your account is temporarily suspended: clients and measurements are not accessible until it is reactivated. Your data is safe and will be available again once the account is reactivated.
